# Mitishell v1.3.4

Bugfix for incomplete logging out.

## Fixes

- Logging out now ends the session completely and returns to the display manager. Previously systemd killed hyprshutdown together with the shell before it could tell Hyprland to exit.

## Install

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.3.4-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.3.4-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.3.4-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
